British Council Scholarships for English Teachers in India 2022 is an initiative by the British Council for Indian master's degree holders. These scholarships are open to individuals working in or with the government schools sector, who have not previously received a scholarship to study at a UK university. The selected candidates will receive fully-funded scholarships to study for a master's level qualification with two leading universities in the UK.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Have masters-level qualifications from two leading universities in the UK
We are offering a full scholarship which will cover:
Stipend for living expenses while in the UK
Flights and connecting travel to the UK
